title: JESUS ACCORDING TO JOHN
theme: John presents Jesus' deity through the titles only begotten Son, Son of man, and good shepherd, and through testimony calling people to life in Him.
proposition: Jesus' titles and the witnesses presented in John establish His deity and call people to come to Him for life.
sermonQuestion: Who is Jesus according to John, and what testimony establishes His deity?

outline.heading: There are three deific phrases in the gospel of John that need some consideration. (Jn.1:18)
The book of John sets forth five witnesses to his deity.

legacyImport.contentPreservation: Original Josh Hetrick legacy sermon preserved unchanged.
